prerequisite: Learner can read the area under y = x squared on [0, 1] as an integral.

scenes.concept_target: Finer Riemann partitions of x squared on [0, 1] shrink the error toward the integral.

narration_cues.change: Axes, curve, four right-hand bars, and the error readout appear.
narration_cues.text: With n=4 right-hand bars, the Riemann sum overshoots the integral of x squared, and the error readout is large. Predict what doubling will do.

narration_cues.change: Four bars become eight hugging the curve; the n label and error readout drop.
narration_cues.text: At n=8 the bars hug the curve more closely, and the error readout drops. Compare with your prediction before the final refinement.

narration_cues.change: Eight bars become sixteen; the error reaches its smallest value and every updater is cleared.
narration_cues.text: At n=16 the bars nearly fill the area under the curve, the error is smallest, and the ending is clean with nothing left behind.

scenes.title: Riemann sum refinement without leftover updaters

success_check: Learner predicts the error shrinks as n doubles from 4 to 16, then compares with the readout.
title: Area accumulation cleanup: Riemann sum refines 4-8-16
